positioning: AI-assisted preliminary Web3 launch security review before expensive professional audit.
primary_disclaimer: This is a preliminary security review and does not replace a full manual audit.
what_we_check: User-submitted Solidity code for common launch-blocking patterns
Safe passive website headers and public readiness signals
dApp frontend checklist risks such as exposed public keys, chain mismatch, and unclear transaction UX
API backend checklist risks such as CORS, docs exposure, missing rate limit, auth, and webhook signature gaps
Wallet flow risks such as unlimited approvals, permit signatures, unknown spender display, and blind signing
Founder/admin OpSec risks such as single owner wallet, missing multisig, no timelock, shared keys, and missing incident response
what_we_do_not_do: We do not claim certified audit coverage from automated scans
We do not guarantee that a project is 100% secure
We do not run exploit automation against third-party systems
We do not brute-force, bypass logins, test credentials, or perform destructive testing
We do not perform deep website or infrastructure testing without ownership verification and written scope
We do not provide investment, legal, tax, or financial advice
scan_boundaries: Website checks are passive by default and use limited HEAD/GET requests only
Deep scans require authorization and future ownership verification
Private/internal IP ranges must be blocked by scanner logic
All URL scans should use timeout, redirect safety, and rate limiting
User must confirm that they own the project or are authorized to scan it
manual_review_scope: Manual review can review scanner findings and prioritize launch fixes
Manual review can inspect submitted code, website, dApp flow, wallet flow, and admin setup within agreed scope
Manual review deliverables depend on selected package and provided project material
Manual review is still not a guarantee of complete security unless separately contracted as a full professional audit by qualified auditors
refund_scope_rules: Free scan has no payment and no refund requirement
Paid quick reports start after payment reference is verified manually
If the project is out of scope before work starts, the lead may be rejected or refunded manually
Once manual review work has started, refunds depend on delivered effort, scope, and written agreement
Any change in scope can require a new quote
responsible_use_summary: Use Web3Guard AI only for projects you own or are authorized to review. Do not use it to probe third-party systems or generate exploit instructions.
data_retention_summary: MVP stores leads and payment references in local JSONL files. Future production should move to encrypted database storage with retention limits and deletion/export workflow.
